text: Gentex Corporation (Nasdaq: GNTX) reported in its 2026 definitive proxy statement that the only beneficial owners of more than five percent of its voting securities as of 31 December 2025 were The Vanguard Group with 9.9% and BlackRock Inc. with 8.3%.
short: Gentex's only 5%-plus owners are Vanguard (9.9%) and BlackRock (8.3%).
